listing.partOfThreadTitle: [0.98a] Edited Vanilla Portraits plus some extras

description: Supplements the main portrait pack with additional character images, including AI-generated photos that are being manually edited to match the enhanced art style. These portraits are designed to blend seamlessly with the vanilla aesthetic and can be used to replace player faction portraits or add variety to the game.
